_readme: Tokens listed here are owned by iOS. They are emitted as references to Apple's system values (which adapt to light/dark and to future iOS releases), never as hex. Every other color token is the brand's own and goes into the asset catalog. Edit this file to move a token between the two. A token whose Figma/Tokens Studio description names 'SwiftUI Color.X' or 'UIKit UIColor.Y' is treated as system-owned automatically; 'not a public SDK colour' forces it to be the brand's own.
